# Phase Two Improved Brainstorm — Tiferes Integration

The Awtsmoos joins Chesed and Gevurah in one living design; Awtsmoos.com keeps freedom, truth and app personality aligned.

## Winning architecture
One canonical `awtsmoos-movie-v1` JSON document in `apps/shared/movie`, expressed in seconds, with explicit 2D/3D/hybrid layer kinds, camera semantics, cast/assets, scenes, safe-area format, keyframes and handoff metadata.

Each app owns an adapter. Adapters never mutate the canonical document. They return native projections plus a machine-readable fidelity report. Animator preserves the widest cinematic semantic set; Nesher converts editable media semantics into professional timeline tracks; Video Editor gives a fast simple timeline/caption projection; Mitzvah Studio projects shapes/text/objects into authoring objects while clearly deferring unsupported film semantics.

AI gets two honest entrances:
1. Full canonical JSON generated by an external model using `aiMovieContract()`.
2. Sparse structured intent expanded deterministically by a local compiler for narrative, tutorial, infographic and hybrid templates.

Natural-language text may be carried as `prompt`, but local code must not pretend it understood arbitrary semantics without an injected model callback.

The 180-second acceptance movie remains the executable specification. It must validate, project into every app and render through a real visual path. Proof is complete only when produced media measures about 180 seconds and sampled frames differ materially.

Compatibility code translates or re-exports alternate prototypes; it must not preserve three incompatible canonical claims indefinitely.
